title: The rack, Tongs and the Whetstone
lines: In The Little Raid the rack shows each kind of item once, with how many you have, and anything on it can be dragged onto the stall to melt for acorns.

Tongs take back everything a figure holds, and a Whetstone turns each component and finished item it holds into another of the same sort; emblems stay. Both come from some rooms' picks, and one figure of each carousel holds Tongs.
